channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Bazzite Deck 44 Launches Today
item.description: Bazzite Deck 44 Launches Today Don’t worry desktop users, there’s major improvements in here for you too! Hello folks! It’s been a hard few months with over 700 commits just to the Bazzite repo. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Emacs 31.1 will release on 8/24
item.description: Biggest thing for me is that tree-sitter's ABI is being bumped to 15 -- fixes compatibility issues with several upstream grammars. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Docker Launches Fully Rebuilt Virtualization Layer to Boost Performance and Improve Dev Experience
item.description: Docker VMM (virtual machine monitor) is Docker's new, first-party virtualization layer for Docker Desktop, replacing third-party virtualization components with an engine that Docker can directly control and optimize specifically for… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS announces the general availability of a new AWS Local Zone in Las Vegas, Nevada
item.description: AWS Local Zone in Las Vegas, Nevada is now generally available. The new AWS Local Zone supports Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C7i, M7i, R7i, and C8gn instances, Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume types gp3, gp2,… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now supports customer managed keys
item.description: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now supports AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys for encrypting data at rest in InfluxDB 2 database instances, InfluxDB 2 Read Replicas, and InfluxDB 3 clusters. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (Seoul) Region
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) P6-B300 instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Seoul) Region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EKS now supports certificate authority (CA) rotation with automated lifecycle management
item.description: Today, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) announced certificate authority (CA) rotation, enabling customers to rotate their cluster's CA through a managed lifecycle with automated safeguards. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports Origin Access Control (OAC) for Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points
item.description: Starting today, customers can protect their origins using Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points (MRAP) by using CloudFront Origin Access Control (OAC) to only allow access from designated CloudFront distributions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Partner Central agents MCP Server now supports OAuth with AWS Sign-In
item.description: AWS partners can now access AWS Partner Central agents from tools they already use, such as Amazon Quick and Kiro, using OAuth through AWS Sign-In. (1 source: aws)
